updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Optical Character Recognition Support for Endpoint
updates.summary: DLP policies will now detect sensitive content within images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, PDF) on Windows endpoints using OCR, preventing exfiltration of data hidden in image files. This extends DLP protection beyond text-based documents to visual content, closing a gap in endpoint data protection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management: Enhanced AI-Driven Experience
updates.summary: Purview is introducing a redesigned DSPM interface with AI observability, intelligent Security Copilot agents for automated policy management and triage, and outcome-based workflows to prioritize and remediate data risks faster. The upgrade extends coverage to AI-driven environments alongside traditional data stores, helping organizations prepare for secure AI adoption.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Sensitivity Labels for Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Sensitivity labels can now be applied directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same label configuration already in use for Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This unifies governance and classification across group types without requiring separate label setup.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
updates.summary: Admins can now export DLP policies and label publishing configurations as a downloadable ZIP file containing schema details, streamlining support troubleshooting and policy documentation. This capability is now generally available.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes with eligible E5 licenses can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit, ensuring continuous retention and enabling scalable archive growth without operational interruption. This removes a critical constraint on long-term data retention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now provides unified access to archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) through a single view, replacing deprecated EWS Graph APIs. This enables programmatic archive mailbox management and streamlines integration with modern applications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging now provides clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions when users access the Purview portal, helping administrators troubleshoot authorization issues and monitor compliance with role-based access controls. This improves accountability for portal access.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Upgraded Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: DLP inline protection for Entra-managed applications in Edge for Business now integrates with Conditional Access grant controls, supporting expanded conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and configurable alerts. Admins gain finer control over data protection without Purview policy restrictions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Maximum daily auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant, enabling faster bulk classification and protection of resting data at scale. This helps organizations close data labeling gaps and prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: DLP and Collection Policies for Intune-Managed Mobile Apps
updates.summary: Purview DLP now protects sensitive data in Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps by evaluating clipboard actions against policies before sharing, reducing data leakage and insider risk on mobile devices. Collection policies can also govern sensitive data handling in managed mobile workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Note Capabilities for Alerts and Cases
updates.summary: Analysts can now add manual notes directly in Insider Risk Management alerts to document investigation progress, with system-generated notes automatically recording status changes and assignments. This centralizes investigation history and improves team collaboration and auditability.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Enhanced User Profile in IRM Alerts
updates.summary: The User section in IRM alerts now displays contextual details such as employee type, office location, start date, priority user group status, and last working day, allowing investigators to build complete user context without leaving the alert interface. This streamlines alert triage and decision-making.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Integration with Entra Global Secure Access (General Availability)
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect text, files, and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. This extends DLP enforcement to network-level access controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Barriers: Policy Compliance Reporting
updates.summary: A new compliance report feature identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers that fall out of compliance after Information Barriers policy changes. This helps admins track policy impact and ensure consistent enforcement across the organization.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Weak authorization controls in Microsoft Exchange Server allow an authenticated attacker to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations should apply available patches immediately to prevent privilege escalation attacks from internal or compromised accounts.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69435: Azure SRE Agent Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authorization controls in Azure SRE Agent enable an authorized attacker to escalate privileges over the network. Administrators should review and restrict SRE Agent permissions and apply patches to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-94510: Microsoft Bookings Authorization Bypass and Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Bookings allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges through user-controlled keys over the network. Organizations using Bookings should apply patches to prevent unauthorized access escalation.
